rubric.reasoning_layers: At least two linked deductions, constraints or conditional checks in every non-trivial item.

questions.text: Passage 1 is principally arguing that: Use the coastal-service ledger as the complete information set for this question.
options: That school learning recovery is mainly technical and therefore has no significant distributive consequences.
That school learning recovery requires aligned incentives, evidence and local feedback rather than one universal prescription.

questions.text: Passage 1 most clearly permits which inference? Use the hill-health register as the complete information set for this question.

questions.text: The reasoning in Passage 1 depends on which assumption? Use the ration audit as the complete information set for this question.

questions.text: If r is the remainder when 3^19 + 4^17 is divided by 18, what is r? Use the river-route log as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Compute powers modulo 18; cyclic reduction gives remainder 7.

questions.text: How many integers from 1 through 106, inclusive, are divisible by 7 or 13, but not by both? Use the border-connectivity map as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Count multiples of 7 and 13, then remove twice the common multiples: the exclusive count is 21.

questions.text: Solution A contains 25% solute and solution B contains 17% solute. If A and B are mixed in the volume ratio 6:1, what is the resulting concentration? Use the vending-permit register as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Use a weighted average: (6×25+17)/(6+1) = 23.86%.

questions.solution: Combined rate = 1/17+1/22+1/36; reciprocal = 7.57 days.

questions.text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row. C is third from the left; A is left of D; B and F are non-adjacent; G is not at an end. Which person cannot occupy fifth position? Use the school-recovery ledger as the complete information set for this question.
options: B
D
C
A
questions.solution: Enumerating all valid arrangements gives possible fifth-position occupants ['A', 'B', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G']; C never appears there.

questions.text: Six candidates P, Q, R, S, T and U are ranked first to sixth. P is above R, R above U, S above R, Q below S, and T is not first. Which candidate cannot be third? Use the municipal works map as the complete information set for this question.
options: P
U
R
Q
questions.solution: Testing all rankings gives possible third-place candidates ['P', 'Q', 'R', 'S', 'T']; U violates the partial-order constraints in every valid ranking.

questions.text: A field worker moves 4 km east and then 8 km north. What is the straight-line distance from the starting point, ignoring the path taken? Use the ward-grievance register as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Displacement = sqrt(4²+8²) = 8.94 km.

questions.text: M is the sister of N. N is the father of P. P is the daughter of Q. Relative to P, what is M? Use the coastal-service ledger as the complete information set for this question.
options: P's grandmother
P's maternal aunt
P's paternal aunt
P's paternal cousin
questions.solution: N is P's father; M is N's sister, so M is P's paternal aunt.

questions.text: Exactly one of A, B and C is guilty and exactly one statement is true. A says B is guilty; B says A and C are innocent; C says B is innocent. Who is guilty? Use the hill-health register as the complete information set for this question.
options: C only
B only
No one
A only
questions.solution: Assume exactly one of A, B and C is guilty and exactly one statement is true. A says B is guilty; B says A and C are innocent; C says B is innocent. Testing A, B and C in turn leaves only B guilty: A and C are then false, while B is true.

questions.text: In an industrial cluster, a file concerning worker-safety inspections is being reviewed by factory inspectors; the available evidence includes incident and audit reports. A pilot produces mixed results across neighbourhoods. How should the administrator respond? Use the coastal-service ledger as the complete information set for this question.
options: Scale it everywhere immediately because any positive result proves universal effectiveness.
Cancel it everywhere immediately because variation means the intervention has failed.
Examine context-specific results, adapt the design and publish the decision rule.
Hide the mixed results until a later evaluation produces a simpler narrative.
questions.solution: Disaggregated evidence supports adaptation rather than premature scaling, cancellation or concealment.

questions.text: In an industrial cluster, a file concerning worker-safety inspections is being reviewed by factory inspectors; the available evidence includes incident and audit reports. A grievance channel receives fewer complaints after a redesign. What is the most careful interpretation? Use the hill-health register as the complete information set for this question.
options: Conclude that the redesign failed because every effective channel should receive more complaints.
Conclude that service quality improved because fewer complaints always mean fewer problems.
Stop monitoring because the lower number already provides a sufficient success signal.
Check accessibility, repeat-use patterns and independent feedback before judging the change.
questions.solution: Complaint counts need accessibility and independent-feedback checks before they can indicate improvement.

questions.text: In an industrial cluster, a file concerning worker-safety inspections is being reviewed by factory inspectors; the available evidence includes incident and audit reports. Assess the risk, apply the documented change-control rule and retain a safe alternative.

questions.solution: A documented risk and change-control assessment protects safety without making procedure an empty ritual.

questions.text: In an industrial cluster, a file concerning worker-safety inspections is being reviewed by factory inspectors; the available evidence includes incident and audit reports. questions.text: In a forest fringe, a file concerning human-wildlife response is being reviewed by range officers; the available evidence includes callout and response records. questions.solution: Triangulation tests measurement and lived experience before a consequential administrative action.

questions.solution: Responsible risk communication is candid about uncertainty while giving a clear time-bound action.

questions.text: In a forest fringe, a file concerning human-wildlife response is being reviewed by range officers; the available evidence includes callout and response records.
